```{r}
library(tidyverse)

setwd("/Users/nityamehrotra/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/ZemmourLab_Nitya/Tregs")

color_palette <- read.csv("immgent_color_palettes_Treg.csv", header = FALSE)
palette_vector <- setNames(color_palette$V2, color_palette$V1)
color_palette$V3 <- c(1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 7, 8, "mini", "prolif")
organ_palette <- read.csv("immgent_color_palettes_organ_simplified.csv", header = FALSE)

treg_object@meta.data <- treg_object@meta.data %>%
  mutate(
    annotation_level2 = case_when(
      annotation_level2 %in% c("Treg_cl7") ~ "Treg_cl1",
      TRUE ~ annotation_level2
    )
  )

treg_object <- NormalizeData(
  treg_object,
  assay = "RNA",
  normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
  layer.name = "data"
)
sample_counts <- treg_object@meta.data %>%
  count(sample_code, name = "cell_count") %>%
  filter(cell_count > 20)

treg_object_clean <- subset(treg_object,subset = !annotation_level2 %in% c("Treg_prolif", "Treg_miniverse"))

treg_object_filtered <- subset(treg_object, subset = sample_code %in% sample_counts$sample_code)
```

```{r}
#figure 2a
#figure 2 surface markers
MyFeatureScatter <- function(
  so,
  assay = "ADT",
  slot = "data",
  feature1,
  feature2,
  group.by,
  split.by = NULL,
  raster = TRUE
) {
  require(scattermore)
  require(ggplot2)
  require(viridis)
  require(MASS)
  require(fields)
  
  # Extract data
  f1_vals <- GetAssayData(so, assay = assay, slot = slot)[feature1, ]
  f2_vals <- GetAssayData(so, assay = assay, slot = slot)[feature2, ]
  
  # Check for valid group.by
  if (!(group.by %in% colnames(so@meta.data))) {
    stop(sprintf("group.by '%s' not found in metadata columns", group.by))
  }
  
  # Create base dataframe
  df <- data.frame(
    feature1 = f1_vals,
    feature2 = f2_vals,
    group.by = so@meta.data[[group.by]]
  )
  
  # Handle split.by (optional)
  if (!is.null(split.by)) {
    if (!(split.by %in% colnames(so@meta.data))) {
      stop(sprintf("split.by '%s' not found in metadata columns", split.by))
    }
    df$split.by <- so@meta.data[[split.by]]
  }
  
  # Subset to TRUE in group.by
  df2 <- df[df$group.by == TRUE, ]
  
  # Calculate density manually using kde2d
  dens <- MASS::kde2d(df2$feature1, df2$feature2, n = 100)
  
  # Interpolate density values for each point
  df2$density <- fields::interp.surface(
    obj = list(x = dens$x, y = dens$y, z = dens$z),
    loc = cbind(df2$feature1, df2$feature2)
  )
  
  # Apply power transformation to spread colors better
  # This expands the low-density range
  df2$density <- df2$density^0.25  # or try 0.3, 0.5
  
  # Normalize to 0-1
  df2$density <- (df2$density - min(df2$density)) / (max(df2$density) - min(df2$density))
  
  # Base plot with all points in gray
  p <- ggplot(df) +
    geom_scattermore(aes(feature1, feature2), color = "grey", pixels = c(512, 512)) +
    { if (raster) geom_scattermore(data = df2, aes(feature1, feature2, color = density), pixels = c(216, 216)) else geom_point(data = df2, aes(feature1, feature2, color = density)) } +
    scale_colour_viridis_c(option = "inferno") +
    xlab(feature1) + ylab(feature2) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 15),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 15),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20),
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
  
  # Add faceting if split.by is provided
  if (!is.null(split.by)) {
    p <- p + facet_wrap(~split.by)
  }
  
  return(p)
}
```

```{r}
#Figure 2c - sorted citeseq
library(viridisLite)
healthy_subset <- subset(treg_object_clean, subset = condition_broad == "healthy")

MyDimPlotHighlightDensity <- function(
  seurat_object = so,
  umap_to_plot = "mde_incremental",
  group.by = NULL,
  split.by = NULL,
  raster = TRUE,
  highlight_size = 0.5,
  highlight_alpha = 0.5,
  cols = rocket(100)
) {
  requireNamespace("scattermore", quietly = TRUE)
  requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)

  if (is.null(group.by)) {
    stop("Please provide a valid column name in `group.by`.")
  }
  df <- data.frame(
    feature1 = seurat_object[[umap_to_plot]]@cell.embeddings[, 1],
    feature2 = seurat_object[[umap_to_plot]]@cell.embeddings[, 2],
    group.by = seurat_object@meta.data[[group.by]]
  )

  if (!is.null(split.by)) {
    df$split.by <- seurat_object@meta.data[[split.by]]
  }

  df2 <- df[df$group.by == TRUE, ]

  df2$density <- densCols(
    df2$feature1,
    df2$feature2,
    colramp = colorRampPalette(cols),
    nbin = 500
  )

  p1 <- ggplot(df) +
    scattermore::geom_scattermore(
      aes(feature1, feature2),
      color = "grey",
      pixels = c(512, 512)
    )

  if (raster) {
    p2 <- scattermore::geom_scattermore(
      data = df2,
      aes(feature1, feature2, color = density),
      pixels = c(216, 216)
    )
  } else {
    p2 <- geom_point(
      data = df2,
      aes(feature1, feature2, color = density),
      size = highlight_size,
      alpha = highlight_alpha
    )
  }

  p3 <- p1 + p2 +
    scale_colour_identity() +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 15),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 15),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20),
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )

  if (!is.null(split.by)) {
    p3 <- p3 + facet_wrap(~split.by)
  }

  return(p3)
}
```

```{r}
healthy_subset <- subset(treg_object_clean, subset = condition_broad == "healthy")
#subset to only include samples with >20 cells
sample_counts <- healthy_subset@meta.data %>%
  count(sample_code, name = "cell_count") %>%
  filter(cell_count > 20)

healthy_subset_filtered <- subset(healthy_subset, subset = sample_code %in% sample_counts$sample_code)

NormalizeData(healthy_subset_filtered, assay = "ADT", normalization.method = "LogNormalize")

flow_subset <- subset(healthy_subset_filtered, subset = organ_simplified %in% c("thymus", "bone marrow", "blood", "spleen", "LN", "lung", "colon", "small intestine", "peritoneal cavity", "liver"))

annotation_counts <- flow_subset@meta.data %>%
  group_by(sample_code, organ_simplified, annotation_level2) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop")


total_sample_data <- annotation_counts %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = annotation_level2, values_from = count, values_fill = 0)
total_sample_data$total <- rowSums(total_sample_data[, 3:8])

total_sample_data <- total_sample_data %>%
  mutate(across(
    .cols = starts_with("Treg_"),
    .fns = ~ .x / total,
    .names = "prop_{.col}"
  ))

prop_long <- total_sample_data %>%
  dplyr::select(organ_simplified, dplyr::starts_with("prop_")) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = dplyr::starts_with("prop_"),
    names_to = "annotation_level2",
    values_to = "proportion"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(annotation_level2 = sub("prop_", "", annotation_level2))



prop_long$percent <- prop_long$proportion * 100

prop_summary_ann <- prop_long %>%
  group_by(organ_simplified, annotation_level2) %>%
  summarise(
    med = median(percent, na.rm = TRUE),
    sem = sd(percent, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#combining meds/sds into one large data frame
cl1_trimmed <- joined_data_cl1[, -(1:4)]
cl2_trimmed <- joined_data_cl2[, -(1:5)]
cl3_trimmed <- joined_data_cl3[, -(1:5)]
cl4_trimmed <- joined_data_cl4[, -(1:5)]
cl6_trimmed <- joined_data_cl6[, -(1:5)]
cl8_trimmed <- joined_data_cl8[, -(1:5)]
total_flow_seq <- rbind(cl1_trimmed, cl2_trimmed, cl3_trimmed, cl4_trimmed, cl8_trimmed)


library(ggradar)
library(fmsb)
organs <- unique(total_flow_seq$organ_simplified)

for (org in organs) {
  sub_df <- subset(total_flow_seq, organ_simplified == org)
  annotations <- sub_df$annotation_level2
  
  flow_med   <- setNames(sub_df$med_flow, annotations)
  flow_upper <- setNames(sub_df$med_flow + sub_df$sem_flow, annotations)
  flow_lower <- setNames(sub_df$med_flow - sub_df$sem_flow, annotations)
  
  rna_med    <- setNames(sub_df$med, annotations)
  rna_upper  <- setNames(sub_df$med + sub_df$sem, annotations)
  rna_lower  <- setNames(sub_df$med - sub_df$sem, annotations)
  
  radar_data <- rbind(
    max = rep(100, length(annotations)),
    min = rep(0, length(annotations)),
    Flow      = flow_med,
    Flow_hi   = flow_upper,
    Flow_lo   = flow_lower,
    RNAseq    = rna_med,
    RNAseq_hi = rna_upper,
    RNAseq_lo = rna_lower
  )
  
  radar_data <- as.data.frame(radar_data)
  colnames(radar_data) <- annotations
  radar_data[is.na(radar_data)] <- 0
  
  colors_border <- c("blue", "blue", "blue", "red", "red", "red")
  colors_fill   <- c("#0000FF40", NA, NA, "#FF000040", NA, NA)
  
  par(mar = c(3, 3, 4, 3), xpd = TRUE) 
  
  radarchart(radar_data,
             axistype = 1,
             pcol = colors_border,
             pfcol = colors_fill,
             plwd = c(2, 1, 1, 2, 1, 1),
             plty = c(1, 2, 2, 1, 2, 2),
             cglcol = "grey", cglty = 1,
             axislabcol = "grey",
             vlcex = 0.8,
             title = paste("Flow vs RNAseq cluster proportions -", org))
  
  legend("topleft", inset = c(0, -0.15), horiz = TRUE,
         legend = c("Flow", "+/-SEM_FLOW", "RNA-seq", "+/-SEM_SEQ"),
         col = c("blue", "blue", "red", "red"),
         lty = c(1, 2, 1, 2),
         lwd = c(2, 1, 2, 1),
         bty = "n",
         xpd = TRUE,
         cex = 0.75)

  n_vars <- length(annotations)
  angles <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = n_vars + 1)[- (n_vars + 1)]
  
  usr <- par("usr")
  x_center <- mean(usr[1:2])
  y_center <- mean(usr[3:4])
  radius <- min(diff(usr[1:2]), diff(usr[3:4])) / 2 * 1.05
  
  for (i in seq_along(annotations)) {
    angle <- angles[i]
    
    base_x <- x_center + radius * sin(angle)
    base_y <- y_center + radius * cos(angle)
    
    label_offset <- 0.08 * radius
    
    flow_val <- round(radar_data["Flow", i], 1)
    rna_val  <- round(radar_data["RNAseq", i], 1)
    
    text(base_x, base_y - label_offset, 
         labels = paste0("Flow: ", flow_val), 
         col = "blue", cex = 0.6, font = 2)
    
    text(base_x, base_y - (3 * label_offset), 
         labels = paste0("RNA: ", rna_val), 
         col = "red", cex = 0.6, font = 2)
  }
}
```

```{r}
#3j - heatmap of colon, lung, ln, SI top dge compared to baseline (spleen)
library(pheatmap)
lfc_thresh <- 2.0
top_n      <- 50

igt_67       <- subset(treg_object, subset = igt_number == "67")
igt_67 <- subset(igt_67, subset = organ_simplified != "thymus")
obj          <- igt_67
organ_col    <- "organ_simplified"
cluster_col  <- "annotation_level2"
cl1_label    <- "Treg_cl1"
baseline_org <- "spleen"
min_cells    <- 10

assay_use <- if ("RNA" %in% Assays(obj)) "RNA" else if ("SCT" %in% Assays(obj)) "SCT" else Assays(obj)[1]
DefaultAssay(obj) <- assay_use

out_dir <- "dge_Treg_cl1_vs_SPLEEN_by_organ"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
sanitize <- function(x) gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9._-]+", "_", x)

org_vals <- sort(unique(obj@meta.data[[organ_col]]))
if (!(baseline_org %in% org_vals)) stop(sprintf("Baseline organ '%s' not found in '%s'.", baseline_org, organ_col))
org_to_compare <- setdiff(org_vals, baseline_org)

results_list <- list()

for (org in org_to_compare) {
  cells_target   <- colnames(obj)[obj@meta.data[[organ_col]] == org         & obj@meta.data[[cluster_col]] == cl1_label]
  cells_baseline <- colnames(obj)[obj@meta.data[[organ_col]] == baseline_org & obj@meta.data[[cluster_col]] == cl1_label]

  if (length(cells_target) < min_cells || length(cells_baseline) < min_cells) next

  sub <- subset(obj, cells = c(cells_target, cells_baseline))
  sub$grp <- ifelse(sub@meta.data[[organ_col]] == org, org, baseline_org)
  Idents(sub) <- sub$grp

  markers <- FindMarkers(
    sub, ident.1 = org, ident.2 = baseline_org, assay = assay_use,
    logfc.threshold = 0, min.pct = 0.1, test.use = "wilcox", verbose = FALSE
  )
  if (!nrow(markers)) next

  res <- markers %>%
    rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
    rename(logFC = avg_log2FC) %>%
    mutate(p_val_adj = pmax(p_val_adj, .Machine$double.xmin), organ = org) %>%
    filter(abs(logFC) > lfc_thresh) %>%
    arrange(p_val_adj, dplyr::desc(logFC))

  if (!nrow(res)) next

  res_top <- res %>% dplyr::slice_head(n = top_n)
  results_list[[org]] <- res_top

  write.csv(
    res_top,
    file.path(out_dir, sprintf("Treg_cl1_%s_vs_%s_top%d_logFCgt%.1f.csv",
                               sanitize(org), sanitize(baseline_org), top_n, lfc_thresh)),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}

if (length(results_list)) {
  combined <- dplyr::bind_rows(results_list, .id = "organ_col_for_list")
  write.csv(
    combined,
    file.path(out_dir, sprintf("Treg_cl1_vs_%s_top%d_ALL_ORGANS_logFCgt%.1f.csv",
                               sanitize(baseline_org), top_n, lfc_thresh)),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  saveRDS(
    lapply(results_list, function(df) df$gene),
    file.path(out_dir, sprintf("top%d_genes_by_organ_vs_%s_logFCgt%.1f.rds",
                               top_n, sanitize(baseline_org), lfc_thresh))
  )

  combined_heat <- dplyr::bind_rows(results_list, .id = "organ_for_list")

  combine_fun <- function(x) {
    x[which.max(abs(x))]
  }

  canonicalize_gene <- function(x) sub("\\.\\d+$", "", trimws(as.character(x)))

  heatmap_df <- combined_heat %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      gene  = canonicalize_gene(gene),
      organ = organ
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(gene, organ) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(logFC = combine_fun(logFC), .groups = "drop") %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      id_cols      = gene,
      names_from   = organ,
      values_from  = logFC,
      values_fill  = 0
    )

  heatmap_mat <- heatmap_df %>%
    tibble::column_to_rownames("gene") %>%
    as.matrix()

  heatmap_mat[!is.finite(heatmap_mat)] <- 0

  desired_col_order <- c("LN", "lung", "small intestine", "colon")
  present_cols      <- intersect(desired_col_order, colnames(heatmap_mat))
  heatmap_mat       <- heatmap_mat[, present_cols, drop = FALSE]

  max_col_idx  <- apply(heatmap_mat, 1, which.max)
  max_col_name <- colnames(heatmap_mat)[max_col_idx]
  max_val      <- apply(heatmap_mat, 1, max)

  row_order_df <- data.frame(
    gene   = rownames(heatmap_mat),
    organ  = factor(max_col_name, levels = present_cols),
    max_val = max_val,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  row_order_df <- row_order_df[order(row_order_df$organ, -row_order_df$max_val), ]
  heatmap_mat  <- heatmap_mat[row_order_df$gene, , drop = FALSE]

  if (nrow(heatmap_mat) > 1 && ncol(heatmap_mat) > 1) {
    labels_row  <- make.unique(rownames(heatmap_mat))
    labels_col  <- colnames(heatmap_mat)   # already in present_cols order
    n_genes      <- nrow(heatmap_mat)
    height_in    <- max(8, min(60, 0.18 * n_genes))
    width_in     <- 12
    fontsize_row <- max(4, min(10, 300 / n_genes))

    pdf(file.path(out_dir, sprintf("heatmap_Treg_cl1_vs_%s_top%d_logFCgt%.1f.pdf",
                                   sanitize(baseline_org), top_n, lfc_thresh)),
        width = 10, height = 30, useDingbats = FALSE)

    pheatmap(
      heatmap_mat,
      scale = "none",
      cluster_rows = FALSE,
      cluster_cols = FALSE,
      clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",
      clustering_distance_cols = "euclidean",
      clustering_method = "complete",
      show_rownames = TRUE,
      show_colnames = TRUE,
      labels_row = labels_row,
      labels_col = labels_col,
      cellheight = 6,
      cellwidth  = 10,
      fontsize_row = fontsize_row,
      fontsize_col = 10,
      color = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(100),
      border_color = "darkgray",
      border_size = 1,
      main = sprintf("Treg_cl1: Organs vs %s (top %d, |log2FC| > %.1f)",
                     baseline_org, top_n, lfc_thresh)
    )

    dev.off()
  }
}
```

```{r}
#5a - organ radar plots
#baseline vs condition - uterus, lung, spleen, colon
treg_object_filtered@meta.data <- treg_object_filtered@meta.data %>%
  mutate(condition_detailed_simplified = case_when(
    condition_detailed_simplified %in% c("CtrachomatisD", "CtrachomatisL2") ~ "Ctrachomatis",
    TRUE ~ condition_detailed_simplified
  ))

treg_object_filtered@meta.data <- treg_object_filtered@meta.data %>%
  mutate(condition_detailed_simplified = case_when(
    condition_detailed_simplified %in% c("B16_ACT", "B16_ACTaPD1a41BB") ~ "B16",
    condition_detailed_simplified %in% c("PDAC_FishHFD", "PDAC_SoyHFD", "PDAC", "PDAC_aPD1aCTLA4") ~ "PDAC",
    condition_detailed_simplified %in% c("GBMmes", "GBMmes_aPD1aCTLA4", "GBMpron_aPD1aCTLA4") ~ "GBM",
    TRUE ~ condition_detailed_simplified
  ))

annotation_counts_cond <- treg_object_filtered@meta.data %>%
  group_by(sample_code, organ_simplified, annotation_level2, condition_detailed_simplified) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop")

total_sample_data_cond <- annotation_counts_cond %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = annotation_level2,
    values_from = count,
    values_fill = 0,
    id_cols = c(sample_code, organ_simplified, condition_detailed_simplified)
  )
total_sample_data_cond$total <- rowSums(total_sample_data_cond[, 4:9])

total_sample_data_cond <- total_sample_data_cond %>%
  mutate(across(
    .cols = starts_with("Treg_"),
    .fns = ~ .x / total,
    .names = "prop_{.col}"
  ))

total_sample_data_cond <- subset(total_sample_data_cond, subset = ! condition_detailed_simplified == "other")

prop_long <- total_sample_data_cond %>%
  select(condition_detailed_simplified, organ_simplified, starts_with("prop_")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("prop_"),
    names_to = "annotation_level2",
    values_to = "proportion"
  ) %>%
  mutate(annotation_level2 = sub("prop_", "", annotation_level2))


prop_long$percent <- prop_long$proportion * 100

prop_summary_ann <- prop_long %>%
  group_by(organ_simplified, annotation_level2, condition_detailed_simplified) %>%
  summarise(
    med = median(percent, na.rm = TRUE),
    sem = sd(percent, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
#5g - cancer radar
annotation_counts_cond <- treg_object_filtered@meta.data %>%
  group_by(sample_code, condition_broad, annotation_level2, condition_detailed_simplified) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop")

total_sample_data_cond <- annotation_counts_cond %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = annotation_level2,
    values_from = count,
    values_fill = 0,
    id_cols = c(sample_code, condition_broad, condition_detailed_simplified)
  )

total_sample_data_cond$total <- rowSums(total_sample_data_cond[, 4:9])

total_sample_data_cond <- total_sample_data_cond %>%
  mutate(across(
    .cols = starts_with("Treg_"),
    .fns = ~ .x / total,
    .names = "prop_{.col}"
  ))

prop_long <- total_sample_data_cond %>%
  select(condition_detailed_simplified, condition_broad, starts_with("prop_")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("prop_"),
    names_to = "annotation_level2",
    values_to = "proportion"
  ) %>%
  mutate(annotation_level2 = sub("prop_", "", annotation_level2))


prop_long$percent <- prop_long$proportion * 100

prop_summary_ann <- prop_long %>%
  group_by(condition_broad, annotation_level2, condition_detailed_simplified) %>%
  summarise(
    med = median(percent, na.rm = TRUE),
    sem = sd(percent, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cancer_radar <- prop_summary_ann %>%

    condition_broad == "cancer",

  )

  )

cancer_radar_wide <- cancer_radar_complete %>%

    values_from = med,
    values_fill = 0,

baseline_name <- "baseline" 

cancer_radar_wide <- cancer_radar_wide %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("condition_detailed_simplified") %>%
  mutate(condition_detailed_simplified = factor(
    condition_detailed_simplified,
    levels = c(baseline_name, setdiff(condition_detailed_simplified, baseline_name))
  )) %>%
  arrange(condition_detailed_simplified) %>%
  column_to_rownames("condition_detailed_simplified")

  cglcol = "grey",
```

```{r}
}
```

```{r}
#5e - kegg pathway analysis
#pathway analysis - this one works
library(msigdbr)
library(fgsea)
library(Seurat)
library(stringr)

assay_use <- "RNA"

Idents(treg_object) <- "annotation_level2"

de <- FindMarkers(
  treg_object,
  ident.1    = "Treg_cl4",
  ident.2    = NULL,
  assay      = assay_use,
  test.use   = "wilcox",
  logfc.threshold = 0.25, 
  min.pct    = 0.1
)

de$gene <- rownames(de)
de <- de %>%
  mutate(
    sign_fc   = sign(avg_log2FC),
    rank_stat = sign_fc * (-log10(p_val + 1e-300))
  )

ranks <- setNames(de$rank_stat, de$gene)
ranks <- sort(ranks, decreasing = TRUE)

species <- "Mus musculus"
m_c2    <- msigdbr(species = species, category = "C2") %>%
  select(gs_name, gene_symbol)
m_all   <- m_c2 %>% filter(grepl("^(KEGG_|REACTOME_|WP_)", gs_name))
genesets <- split(m_all$gene_symbol, m_all$gs_name)

canon     <- function(x) x |> toupper() |> str_replace_all("[^A-Z0-9]+", "_") |> str_replace_all("^_|_$", "")
gs_names  <- names(genesets)
canon_map <- setNames(gs_names, canon(gs_names))
pick_set  <- function(label) {
  key <- canon(label)
  if (key %in% names(canon_map)) canon_map[[key]] else NA_character_
}
safe_file <- function(x) gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9._-]+", "_", x)

targets <- c(
  "KEGG_LEUKOCYTE_TRANSENDOTHELIAL_MIGRATION",
  "REACTOME_RAP1_SIGNALLING",
  "WP_REGULATION_OF_ACTIN_CYTOSKELETON"
)

grDevices::pdf.options(useDingbats = FALSE)

for (lbl in targets) {
  nm <- pick_set(lbl)
  if (is.na(nm)) { message("No pathway found for: ", lbl); next }

  pw_genes <- intersect(unique(genesets[[nm]]), names(ranks))
  if (length(pw_genes) < 5) { message("Too few overlapping genes for: ", nm); next }

  res <- fgsea(
    pathways = list(this = pw_genes),
    stats    = ranks,
    minSize  = 5, maxSize = Inf,
    nperm    = 10000
  ) |> as.data.frame()

  p <- fgsea::plotEnrichment(pw_genes, ranks) +
    ggtitle(
      nm,
      subtitle = sprintf("NES = %.2f, FDR = %.2g  [cl4 vs all]",
                         res$NES[1], res$padj[1])
    ) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 12))

  print(p)

  outfile <- paste0(safe_file(nm), "_enrichment.pdf")
  tryCatch({
    ggplot2::ggsave(filename = outfile, plot = p,
                    device = grDevices::cairo_pdf,
                    width = 9, height = 5, units = "in", bg = "white")
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("PDF failed for ", nm, ". Falling back to PNG.")
    ggplot2::ggsave(filename = paste0(safe_file(nm), "_enrichment.png"),
                    plot = p, width = 9, height = 5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  })
}
```

```{r}
#Fig S3c - ppv
TpTnFpFn <- function(x, y) {
  x <- as.logical(x); y <- as.logical(y)
  c(
    tp = sum(x &  y, na.rm = TRUE),
    tn = sum(!x & !y, na.rm = TRUE),
    fp = sum(x & !y, na.rm = TRUE),
    fn = sum(!x &  y, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

SeSpPPVNPV <- function(tp, tn, fp, fn) {
  se  <- if ((tp + fn) > 0) tp / (tp + fn) else NA_real_
  sp  <- if ((tn + fp) > 0) tn / (tn + fp) else NA_real_
  ppv <- if ((tp + fp) > 0) tp / (tp + fp) else NA_real_
  npv <- if ((tn + fn) > 0) tn / (tn + fn) else NA_real_
  c(se = se, sp = sp, ppv = ppv, npv = npv)
}

na_false <- function(v) { v[is.na(v)] <- FALSE; v }

DefaultAssay(treg_object) <- if ("ADT" %in% Assays(treg_object)) "ADT" else DefaultAssay(treg_object)
treg_object_cite <- NormalizeData(treg_object, assay = "ADT", normalization.method = "LogNormalize")
adt_data <- GetAssayData(treg_object_cite, assay = "ADT", slot = "data")

if (!identical(rownames(treg_object_cite@meta.data), colnames(treg_object_cite))) {
  rownames(treg_object_cite@meta.data) <- colnames(treg_object_cite)
}

required_markers <- c("CD62L","KLRG1","CD49B","NEUROPILIN1.CD304","FR4","CD29","CD69","SCA1")
missing_markers  <- setdiff(required_markers, rownames(adt_data))
if (length(missing_markers) > 0) {
  warning("Missing ADT markers not found and will be treated as FALSE in gates: ",
          paste(missing_markers, collapse = ", "))
}

gt <- function(marker) {
  if (marker %in% rownames(adt_data)) adt_data[marker, ] else rep(FALSE, ncol(adt_data))
}
val <- function(marker) {
  if (marker %in% rownames(adt_data)) adt_data[marker, ] else rep(NA_real_, ncol(adt_data))
}

gate_list <- list(
  "Treg_cl1" = colnames(treg_object_cite)[ na_false(val("CD62L") > 4) ],
  "Treg_cl2" = colnames(treg_object_cite)[ na_false(val("CD62L") < 4 & val("KLRG1") > 4 & val("CD49B") < 4) ],
  "Treg_cl3" = colnames(treg_object_cite)[ na_false(val("CD62L") < 4 & val("CD49B") < 4 & 
                                                     val("NEUROPILIN1.CD304") > 5 & val("FR4") > 6 &
                                                     val("KLRG1") < 4 & val("CD29") < 5) ],

  
  "Treg_cl4" = colnames(treg_object_cite)[ na_false(val("CD62L") < 4 & val("CD49B") > 4 &
                                                     val("KLRG1") < 4 & val("CD69") <= 4 & val("CD29") > 5) ],
  "Treg_cl8" = colnames(treg_object_cite)[ na_false(val("CD62L") < 4 & val("KLRG1") < 4 &
                                                     val("CD49B") < 4 & val("SCA1") > 5 &
                                                     val("NEUROPILIN1.CD304") < 5 & val("CD29") < 5) ]
)

treg_object_cite$annotation_level2 <- trimws(as.character(treg_object_cite$annotation_level2))
if (!"sample_code" %in% colnames(treg_object_cite@meta.data)) {
  stop("`sample_code` not found in metadata. Please add a per-sample identifier column named `sample_code`.")
}
sample_ids <- sort(unique(na.omit(treg_object_cite$sample_code)))

stats_list <- vector("list", length(gate_list))
names(stats_list) <- names(gate_list)

for (pop in names(gate_list)) {
  truth_col <- sprintf("is_%s", pop)
  treg_object_cite@meta.data[[truth_col]] <- (treg_object_cite$annotation_level2 == pop)

  if (!any(treg_object_cite@meta.data[[truth_col]], na.rm = TRUE)) {
    stats_list[[pop]] <- tibble()
    next
  }

  per_sample <- map(sample_ids, function(s) {
    tmp <- dplyr::filter(treg_object_cite@meta.data, sample_code == s)
    if (nrow(tmp) == 0L) return(NULL)

    x <- rownames(tmp) %in% gate_list[[pop]]
    y <- tmp[[truth_col]] 

    cont <- TpTnFpFn(x, y)
    m    <- SeSpPPVNPV(tp = cont["tp"], tn = cont["tn"], fp = cont["fp"], fn = cont["fn"])

    tibble(
      se  = as.numeric(m["se"]),
      sp  = as.numeric(m["sp"]),
      ppv = as.numeric(m["ppv"]),
      npv = as.numeric(m["npv"]),
      tp  = as.numeric(cont["tp"]),
      tn  = as.numeric(cont["tn"]),
      fp  = as.numeric(cont["fp"]),
      fn  = as.numeric(cont["fn"]),
      ncells     = sum(y, na.rm = TRUE),
      total_n    = nrow(tmp),
      prevalence = sum(y, na.rm = TRUE) / nrow(tmp),
      pop = pop,
      sample_code = s
    )
  })

  stats_list[[pop]] <- bind_rows(per_sample)
}

stats <- bind_rows(stats_list) %>% as_tibble()

stats <- stats %>%
  mutate(
    se  = ifelse((tp + fn) > 0, tp / (tp + fn), NA_real_),
    sp  = ifelse((tn + fp) > 0, tn / (tn + fp), NA_real_),
    ppv = ifelse((tp + fp) > 0, tp / (tp + fp), NA_real_),
    npv = ifelse((tn + fn) > 0, tn / (tn + fn), NA_real_),
    keep = (prevalence > 0.2) & (total_n >= 50)
  )

p_ppv <- ggplot(stats, aes(x = pop, y = ppv, color = pop)) +
  geom_boxplot(
    data = dplyr::filter(stats, keep),
    outlier.shape = NA,
    color = "black"
  ) +
 # geom_jitter(
 #   data = dplyr::filter(stats, keep),
 #   width = 0.2,
  #  size = 2,
  #  alpha = 0.9,
  #  color = "black"
#  ) +
 # geom_jitter(
 #   data = dplyr::filter(stats, !keep),
 #   width = 0.2,
#    size = 0.6,
  #  alpha = 0.45,
 #   color = "black"
#  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  # scale_color_manual(values = palette_vector) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "PPV per Gated Population Across Samples",
    x = "Gated Population",
    y = "Positive Predictive Value (PPV)"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title   = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

print(p_ppv)

#ggsave("091925_ppv_nodots.pdf", p_ppv, width = 12, height = 12)
```

```{r}
#taking top 10-15 genes (LFC>2.0) for one vs all for each cluster - heatmap

onevsall_cluster <- read.table("ttlist_OneVsAll.txt", header = TRUE)
logfc_cols <- grep("^log2FC_", names(onevsall_cluster), value = TRUE)

col_order <- c(
  "log2FC_Treg_cl1_vs_All","log2FC_Treg_cl3_vs_All","log2FC_Treg_cl6_vs_All",
  "log2FC_Treg_cl2_vs_All","log2FC_Treg_cl8_vs_All","log2FC_Treg_cl4_vs_All"
)

hm_df <- onevsall_cluster %>% select(SYMBOL, all_of(logfc_cols))
rownames(hm_df) <- hm_df$SYMBOL
hm_mat <- hm_df %>% select(-SYMBOL) %>% as.matrix()
hm_mat <- hm_mat[, match(col_order, colnames(hm_mat)), drop = FALSE]

top_n <- 10
get_topn <- function(mat, colname, n = 10) {
  v <- mat[, colname]
  ord <- order(v, decreasing = TRUE, na.last = NA)
  head(rownames(mat)[ord], n)
}
tops_list <- lapply(col_order, function(cn) get_topn(hm_mat, cn, top_n))
names(tops_list) <- col_order

rows_dup <- unlist(tops_list, use.names = FALSE)
group_tag_dup <- rep(col_order, times = lengths(tops_list))
keep_idx <- !duplicated(rows_dup)
rows_uniq <- rows_dup[keep_idx]
group_tag_uniq <- group_tag_dup[keep_idx]

sizes_uniq <- as.integer(table(factor(group_tag_uniq, levels = col_order)))
gaps_row_uniq <- cumsum(sizes_uniq)

hm_mat_uniq <- hm_mat[rows_uniq, , drop = FALSE]
hm_mat_uniq <- t(scale(t(hm_mat_uniq)))
max_abs <- max(abs(hm_mat_uniq), na.rm = TRUE)
breaks  <- seq(-max_abs, max_abs, length.out = 101)
cols    <- colorRampPalette(c("darkblue", "white", "red"))(100)

pdf("top10_per_column_onevsall.pdf", width = 10, height = 20, useDingbats = FALSE)
pheatmap(
  hm_mat_uniq,
  color = cols,
  breaks = breaks,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  border_color = "lightgray",
  fontsize_row = 8,
  fontsize_col = 9,
  cellwidth = 8,
  cellheight = 8,
  main = "Top 10 Genes per Column (Scaled Across Rows)"
)
dev.off()

```


```{r}
#adt only - volcano plot of treg vs tconv top genes
adt_so <- readRDS("igt1_96_withtotalvi20250710_clean_ADTonly.Rds")
vol_sub <- subset(adt_so, subset = annotation_level1 %in% c("CD4", "Treg"))
vol_sub <- subset(vol_sub, subset = !(annotation_level2 %in% c("Treg_cl1", "Treg_cl7")))
metadata <- vol_sub@meta.data


CD4 <- metadata$annotation_level1 == "CD4"
Treg <- metadata$annotation_level1 == "Treg"
cd4 <- CD4
treg <- Treg
Idents(vol_sub) = "annotation_level1"
treg_vol= NormalizeData(vol_sub, assay = "ADT", normalization.method = "LogNormalize")
markers <- FindMarkers(
  treg_vol,
  ident.1 = "CD4",
  ident.2 = "Treg"
)
markers$Significance <- with(
  markers,
  ifelse(avg_log2FC > 1 & p_val < 0.05, "Upregulated",
         ifelse(avg_log2FC < -1 & p_val < 0.05, "Downregulated", "Not Significant"))
)

label_these <- rownames(markers)[abs(markers$avg_log2FC) > 1.0]

EnhancedVolcano(markers, 
                lab = rownames(markers),
                selectLab = label_these,
                x = "avg_log2FC",
                y = "p_val",
                title = "Tconv vs Treg: Differentially Expressed Surface Markers according to Citeseq ",
                pointSize = 1.0,
                labSize = 3.0,
                col = c("gray", "gray", "gray", "red")
) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0))

```

```{r}
#same volcano plot just with ggplot

lfc_cutoff <- 1.2 
p_cutoff   <- 0.05

volc_df <- markers %>%
  rownames_to_column("feature") %>%
  mutate(
    neg_log10_padj = -log10(p_val_adj + 1e-300),
    direction = case_when(
      avg_log2FC >  lfc_cutoff & p_val_adj < p_cutoff ~ "Tconv_enriched",
      avg_log2FC < -lfc_cutoff & p_val_adj < p_cutoff ~ "Treg_enriched",
      TRUE                                            ~ "ns"
    )
  )

label_genes <- volc_df %>%
  filter(p_val_adj < p_cutoff, abs(avg_log2FC) > 1.5) %>%
  pull(feature)


ggplot(volc_df, aes(x = avg_log2FC, y = neg_log10_padj, color = direction)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 1.8) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = subset(volc_df, feature %in% label_genes),
    aes(label = feature),
    size = 2,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    box.padding = 0.3,
    point.padding = 0.1
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Tconv_enriched"  = "darkblue",
      "Treg_enriched" = "darkred",
      "ns"            = "darkgray"
    ),
    breaks = c("Tconv_enriched", "Treg_enriched", "ns"),
    name   = "Direction"
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-lfc_cutoff, lfc_cutoff),
             linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(p_cutoff),
             linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    title = "Tconvs vs Activated Tregs (ADT) – Differential surface markers",
    subtitle = "Right = higher in Tconv, Left = higher in Treg",
    x = "avg log2FC (Tconv vs Treg, ADT)",
    y = "-log10(adj p-value)"
  )

```

```{r}
#rnaseq vs flow plots
igt_flow <- read.csv("igt_flow3.csv", row.names = 1)

rownames(igt_flow) <- c("thymus", "bone marrow", "blood", "spleen", "LN", "lung", "colon", "small intestine", "peritoneal cavity", "liver")

healthy_subset <- subset(treg_object_clean, subset = condition_broad == "healthy")
#subset to only include samples with >20 cells
sample_counts <- healthy_subset@meta.data %>%
  count(sample_code, name = "cell_count") %>%
  filter(cell_count > 20)

healthy_subset_filtered <- subset(healthy_subset, subset = sample_code %in% sample_counts$sample_code)

NormalizeData(healthy_subset_filtered, assay = "RNA", normalization.method = "LogNormalize")

flow_subset <- subset(healthy_subset_filtered, subset = organ_simplified %in% c("thymus", "bone marrow", "blood", "spleen", "LN", "lung", "colon", "small intestine", "peritoneal cavity", "liver"))

annotation_counts <- flow_subset@meta.data %>%
  group_by(sample_code, organ_simplified, annotation_level2) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop")


total_sample_data <- annotation_counts %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = annotation_level2, values_from = count, values_fill = 0)
total_sample_data$total <- rowSums(total_sample_data[, 3:8])

total_sample_data <- total_sample_data %>%
  mutate(across(
    .cols = starts_with("Treg_"),
    .fns = ~ .x / total,
    .names = "prop_{.col}"
  ))


prop_long <- total_sample_data %>%
  select(organ_simplified, starts_with("prop_")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("prop_"),
    names_to = "annotation_level2",
    values_to = "proportion"
  ) %>%
  mutate(annotation_level2 = sub("prop_", "", annotation_level2))


prop_long$percent <- prop_long$proportion * 100

prop_summary_ann <- prop_long %>%
  group_by(organ_simplified, annotation_level2) %>%
  summarise(
    med = median(percent, na.rm = TRUE),
    sem = sd(percent, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
#cl1
cl1_flow <- igt_flow %>%
  select(starts_with("Cl1."))
cl1_flow$med_flow <- apply(cl1_flow, 1, median, na.rm = TRUE)
#cl1_flow$sd <- sd(med_flow, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n())
cl1_flow$sem_flow <- apply(cl1_flow, 1, function(x) sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(x))))
cl1_flow$organ_simplified <- rownames(cl1_flow)
cl1_flow <- cl1_flow %>%
  arrange(med_flow)

prop_summary_cl1 <- subset(prop_summary_ann, subset = annotation_level2 == "Treg_cl1")
joined_data_cl1 <- left_join(cl1_flow, prop_summary_cl1, join_by("organ_simplified"))

library(ggpubr)
ggplot(joined_data_cl1, aes(x = med, y = med_flow, label = organ_simplified)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text_repel(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = med_flow - sem_flow, ymax = med_flow + sem_flow), width = 2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "lightgray", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = med - sem, xmax = med + sem), height = 2) +
  stat_cor(method = "pearson", label.y = 90, aes(label = paste(..rr.label.., ..p.label.., sep = "~`,`~")), linewidth = 3.5) +
  #scale_x_continuous(limits = c(1, 100)) +
 # scale_y_continuous(limits = c(1, 100)) +
```

```{r}
#all cancer/tumor >20 cells, prop of every t cell (use adt), split by sample name
cancer_sub_adt <- subset(adt_so, subset = condition_broad == "cancer")
cancer_all_metadata <- cancer_sub_adt@meta.data

cancer_all_metadata <- cancer_all_metadata %>%
  mutate(condition_detailed_simplified = case_when(
    condition_detailed_simplified %in% c("GBMclass", "GBMclass_aPD1aCTLA4", "GBMmes", "GBmesM_aPD1aCTLA4", "GBMpron", "GBMpron_aPD1aCTLA4") ~ "GBM",
    condition_detailed_simplified %in% c("B16_ACT", "B16_ACTaPD1a41BB") ~ "B16",
    condition_detailed_simplified %in% c("PDAC", "PDAC_aPD1aCTLA4", "PDAC_FishHFD","PDAC_SoyHFD") ~ "PDAC",
    TRUE ~ condition_detailed_simplified
  ))


sample_totals <- cancer_all_metadata %>%
  group_by(condition_detailed_simplified, sample_name) %>%
  summarise(total_cells = n(), .groups = "drop")

samples_keep <- sample_totals %>%
  filter(total_cells > 20)

cancer_filtered <- cancer_all_metadata %>%
  semi_join(samples_keep, by = c("condition_detailed_simplified", "sample_name"))

cancer_props <- cancer_filtered %>%
  group_by(annotation_level1, condition_detailed_simplified, sample_name) %>%
  summarise(
    count = n(),
    total_cells = first(samples_keep$total_cells[
      samples_keep$sample_name == sample_name &
        samples_keep$condition_detailed_simplified == condition_detailed_simplified
    ]),
    proportion = count / total_cells,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cancer_props$percent <- cancer_props$proportion * 100

write_xlsx(cancer_props, "111825_cancerprops.xlsx")
```

```{r}
full_data <- readRDS("igt1_96_withtotalvi20250710_clean.Rds")
full_data <- NormalizeData(full_data, assay = "RNA",normalization.method = "LogNormalize", layer.name = "data")

meta <- full_data@meta.data
rna  <- GetAssayData(full_data, assay = "RNA", slot = "data")

foxp3<- meta %>%
  mutate(Foxp3_expr = rna["Foxp3", ]) %>%
  filter(Foxp3_expr > 0)

anno_overall <- foxp3 %>%
  count(annotation_level2, name = "n_cells") %>%
  mutate(prop = n_cells / sum(n_cells))

write.csv(anno_overall,
          "Foxp3pos_annotation_level2_overall.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)


meta$Foxp3_expr <- rna["Foxp3", ]
total_by_ann2 <- meta %>%
  count(annotation_level2, name = "total_cells")
foxp3_by_ann2 <- meta %>%
  filter(Foxp3_expr > 0) %>%
  count(annotation_level2, name = "foxp3_pos")
foxp3_prop <- total_by_ann2 %>%
  left_join(foxp3_by_ann2, by = "annotation_level2") %>%
  mutate(
    foxp3_pos = replace_na(foxp3_pos, 0),
    prop_foxp3 = foxp3_pos / total_cells
  )

foxp3_prop <-foxp3_prop%>%
  mutate(prop_percent = prop_foxp3 * 100)

write.csv(
  foxp3_prop,
  "PercentFoxp3_by_annotation_level2.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

pdf("PercentFoxp3_by_annotation_level2.pdf", width = 50, height = 8)

  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,100)) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(

#boxplots comparing GP68 expression of Tregs, CD4s overall, and Foxp3+ CD4s

gp_col <- "F68"
program_scores <- L1[Cells(full_data),gp_col]
full_data$program_score <- program_scores
obj <- full_data
program_col <- "program_score" 
threshold   <- 0  

rna_mat <- GetAssayData(obj, assay = "RNA", slot = "data")

meta <- obj@meta.data %>%
  mutate(
    Foxp3_expr = rna_mat["Foxp3", Cells(obj)],
    group = case_when(
      annotation_level1 == "Treg"                       ~ "Treg",
      annotation_level1 == "CD4" & Foxp3_expr > 0       ~ "Foxp3+ CD4",
      annotation_level1 == "CD4"                        ~ "CD4 overall",
      TRUE                                              ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(group)) %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(group, levels = c("Treg", "Foxp3+ CD4", "CD4 overall"))
  )



pdf("112125_boxplot.pdf", width = 10, height = 10, useDingbats = FALSE)

  labs(

    y = "GP68 Score",
    title = "GP68 Score Across Groups" 
  )
dev.off()

#% expressing, not just raw program score
boxplot_data <- meta %>%
  mutate(program_pos = .data[[program_col]] > threshold) %>%
  group_by(sample_name, group) %>%
  summarise(
    n_cells    = n(),
    n_pos      = sum(program_pos),
    percent_pos = 100 * n_pos / n_cells,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

pdf("112125_boxplot_percent.pdf", width = 10, height = 10, useDingbats = FALSE)
ggplot(boxplot_data, aes(x = group, y = percent_pos)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_classic() +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 100)) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "% cells expressing program",
    title = "Gene program expression by T cell subset"
  )
dev.off()
```

```{r}
  select(sample_code, condition_detailed_simplified, annotation_level1, prop) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = annotation_level1,
    values_from = prop,
    values_fill = 0
  )

write.csv(wide_tbl,
          "120125_spleen_annotation_level1.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
                row.names = 1,
                check.names = FALSE)

mat_sub <- mat[rownames(mat) != "Treg.cl7",
               colnames(mat) != "Treg.cl7"]
mat_sub <- mat_sub[rownames(mat_sub), colnames(mat_sub)]


max_val <- max(mat_sub, na.rm = TRUE)
breaks  <- seq(0, max_val, length.out = 101)

red_pal <- colorRampPalette(c("white", "red", "darkred"))(100)

pheatmap(
  mat_sub,
  color            = red_pal,
  breaks           = breaks,
  cluster_rows     = FALSE, 
  cluster_cols     = FALSE, 
  border_color     = NA,
  fontsize_row     = 10,
  fontsize_col     = 10,
  main             = "Treg P-clonotype sharing (%)"
)
```

```{r}
#flow-like plots to replace rosetta plots


MyFeatureScatter = function(so = so,
                            assay = "ADT",
                            slot = "data",
                            feature1 = NULL,
                            feature2 = NULL,
                            group.by = sprintf("is_%s", cl),
                            split.by = NULL,
                            raster = T,
                            cols = rev(rainbow(10, end = 4/6)),
                            highlight_size = 1,
                            highlight_alpha = 1) {
    requireNamespace("scattermore", quietly = TRUE)
    requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)

    if (is.null(feature1) || is.null(feature2)) {
        stop("Please provide feature1 and feature2 for MyFeatureScatter.")
    }
    # Ensure features exist in the specified assay and slot
    if (!feature1 %in% rownames(so[[assay]][slot])) {
        stop(paste0("Feature1 '", feature1, "' not found in assay '", assay, "', slot '", slot, "'."))
    }
    if (!feature2 %in% rownames(so[[assay]][slot])) {
        stop(paste0("Feature2 '", feature2, "' not found in assay '", assay, "', slot '", slot, "'."))
    }

    df = data.frame(feature1 = so[[assay]][slot][feature1,],feature2 = so[[assay]][slot][feature2,], group.by = so@meta.data[,group.by])
    if (!is.null(split.by)) {
        df$split.by = so@meta.data[,split.by]
    }

    df2 = df[df$group.by == T,]
    df2$density = densCols(df2$feature1, df2$feature2, colramp = colorRampPalette(cols), nbin = 500)

    p1 = ggplot(df) + scattermore::geom_scattermore(aes(feature1, feature2), color = "grey", pixels = c(512, 512))
    if (raster == T ){
        p2 = scattermore::geom_scattermore(data = df2, aes(feature1, feature2, color = density), pointsize = highlight_size, pixels = c(216, 216))
    } else {
        p2 = geom_point(data = df2, aes(feature1, feature2, color = density), size = highlight_size, alpha = highlight_alpha)
    }
    if(is.null(split.by)) {
        p3 = p1 + p2 + xlab(feature1) + ylab(feature2) +scale_colour_identity()+  theme_bw() + theme(axis.text.x=element_text(size=15), axis.text.y=element_text(size=15), legend.text=element_text(size=10), axis.title.x = element_text(size=20) , axis.title.y = element_text(size=20), legend.title = element_blank(), panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
    } else {
        p3 = p1 + p2 + xlab(feature1) + ylab(feature2) +scale_colour_identity()+  theme_bw() + theme(axis.text.x=element_text(size=15), axis.text.y=element_text(size=15), legend.text=element_text(size=10), axis.title.x = element_text(size=20) , axis.title.y = element_text(size=20), legend.title = element_blank(), panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) + facet_wrap(~split.by)
    }
    return(p3)
}
```

```{r}
GSE290617 <- readRDS("GSE290617.Rds")
IL10pos_Treg <- subset(GSE290617, subset = celltype_label == "IL10+ Treg")
meta <- IL10pos_Treg@meta.data
total_tregs <- meta %>%
  count(celltype_label, name = "total_tregs")

cluster_summary <- meta %>%
  count(celltype_label, level2_final, name = "n_cells") %>%
  left_join(total_tregs, by = "celltype_label") %>%
  mutate(
    pct_within_tregs = 100 * n_cells / total_tregs
  )
cluster_summary <- cluster_summary %>%
  mutate(
    gse = "GSE290617",
    gsm = celltype_label
  ) %>%
  relocate(gse, gsm)


IL10neg_Treg <- subset(
  GSE290617,
  subset = celltype_label == "IL10- Treg"
)

cluster_summary_neg <- IL10neg_Treg@meta.data %>%
  count(celltype_label, level2_final, name = "n_cells") %>%
  group_by(celltype_label) %>%
  mutate(
    total_tregs = sum(n_cells),
    pct_within_tregs = 100 * n_cells / total_tregs
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    gse = "GSE290617",
    celltype_label = "IL10- Treg",
    gsm = celltype_label
  ) %>%
  relocate(gse, gsm, celltype_label)


cluster_summary_all <- bind_rows(
  cluster_summary,
  cluster_summary_neg
)

cluster_summary_all <- cluster_summary_all %>%
  rename(cluster = level2_final)
```

```{r}
#top 5 TFs/cluster for all samples > 20 cells
sample_keep <- treg_object@meta.data %>%
  count(sample_code) %>%
  filter(n > 20) %>%
  pull(sample_code)

treg_filt <- subset(treg_object, subset = sample_code %in% sample_keep)
treg_filt <- subset(
  treg_filt,
  subset = !annotation_level2 %in% c("Treg_miniverse", "Treg_prolif")
)

treg_filt <- NormalizeData(treg_filt, assay = "RNA", normalization.method = "LogNormalize")

tf_list <- unique(dorothea_mm$tf)

avg_exp <- AverageExpression(
  treg_filt,
  group.by = "annotation_level2",
  assays = "RNA",
  slot = "data"
)$RNA

tf_present <- intersect(rownames(avg_exp), tf_list)
avg_tf <- avg_exp[tf_present, , drop = FALSE]

top5_by_cluster <- lapply(colnames(avg_tf), function(cl){
  head(names(sort(avg_tf[, cl], decreasing=TRUE)), 5)
})
names(top5_by_cluster) <- colnames(avg_tf)

top_genes <- unique(unlist(top5_by_cluster))

library(pheatmap)
mat <- avg_tf[top_genes, , drop=FALSE]
pheatmap(mat, cluster_rows=TRUE, cluster_cols=TRUE,

#onevsall


DefaultAssay(treg_filt) <- "RNA"

cluster_order <- c(
  "Treg_cl1","Treg_cl2","Treg_cl3","Treg_cl4",
  "Treg_cl6","Treg_cl8"
)

cluster_order_use <- intersect(cluster_order, unique(treg_filt$annotation_level2))

Idents(treg_filt) <- "annotation_level2"

tf_list <- unique(dorothea_mm$tf)
tf_present <- intersect(rownames(treg_filt), tf_list)

markers_tf <- FindAllMarkers(
  treg_filt,
  features = tf_present,
  only.pos = TRUE,
  logfc.threshold = 0.25,
  min.pct = 0.1,
  test.use = "wilcox"
)

top5_tf <- markers_tf %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = avg_log2FC, n = 5, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

top_genes <- unique(top5_tf$gene)

avg_exp <- AverageExpression(
  treg_filt,
  group.by = "annotation_level2",
  assays = "RNA",
  slot = "data"
)$RNA



cluster_order_use <- gsub("_", "-", cluster_order)
cluster_order_use <- intersect(cluster_order_use, colnames(avg_exp))

avg_exp <- avg_exp[, cluster_order_use, drop = FALSE]


mat <- avg_exp[top_genes, , drop = FALSE]

keep <- apply(mat, 1, sd) > 1e-6
mat <- mat[keep, , drop = FALSE]

mat_scaled <- t(scale(t(mat)))

pheatmap(
  mat,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(100)
)
```

```{r}
#for each sample per cluster, could you plot a histogram the expression of Bach2, Nr4a2, Zbtb20, irf7, Rarg, Pa2g4, Myc, and Rorc
tfs <- c("Bach2", "Nr4a2", "Zbtb20", "Irf7", "Rarg", "Pa2g4", "Myc", "Rorc")
present <- intersect(tfs, rownames(treg_filt[["RNA"]]))
missing <- setdiff(tfs, present)
df <- FetchData(
  treg_filt,
  vars = c(present, "annotation_level2", "sample_code"),
  layer = "data"
) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(present), names_to = "TF", values_to = "expr") %>%
  mutate(
    annotation_level2 = as.character(annotation_level2),
    sample_code = as.character(sample_code)
  )


tfs <- c("Bach2", "Nr4a2", "Zbtb20", "Irf7", "Rarg", "Pa2g4", "Myc", "Rorc")

for (tf in tfs) {
  p <- df %>%
    filter(TF == tf, expr > 0) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = expr)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 50) +
    facet_wrap(~ annotation_level2, scales = "free_y") +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(
      title = tf,
      x = "log-normalized expression (expr > 0)",
      y = "Cell count"
    )

  print(p)
}

```

```{r}

clusters_use <- c("Treg_cl1", "Treg_cl2", "Treg_cl3", "Treg_cl4", "Treg_cl8")

treg_fc <- subset(
  treg_filt,
  subset = annotation_level2 %in% clusters_use
)

treg_fc$annotation_level2 <- factor(
  treg_fc$annotation_level2,
  levels = clusters_use
)

Idents(treg_fc) <- "annotation_level2"
DefaultAssay(treg_fc) <- "RNA"
tf_list <- unique(dorothea_mm$tf)
tf_present <- intersect(rownames(treg_fc), tf_list)

markers_tf <- FindAllMarkers(
  treg_fc,
  features = tf_present,
  only.pos = FALSE,
  logfc.threshold = 0,
  min.pct = 0.1,
  test.use = "wilcox"
)

top10_tf <- markers_tf %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = abs(avg_log2FC), n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

tf_union <- unique(top10_tf$gene)

fc_mat <- top10_tf %>%
  select(gene, cluster, avg_log2FC) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = cluster,
    values_from = avg_log2FC,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("gene")

fc_mat <- fc_mat[, clusters_use, drop = FALSE]
pheatmap(
  fc_mat,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("darkblue", "white", "red"))(100)
)

```
